# Change Overview

A description of the purpose for your change. If it relates to a design in Confluence or elsewhere, include a link.

## Change types

Specify the applicable change types to help reviewers understand the potential risks of this change.

_Put an `x` in the box for each that applies_

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change to fix an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change to add functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (changes which will affect customers or downstream dependents)
- [ ] Other/None of the above (e.g. low-risk refactoring, changes to documentation, pipelines, tests, etc.)

## Checklist

If you aren't ready to check all the boxes, start with a draft pull request, and update these as you go.

_Put an `x` in the box for each that applies_

- [ ] The PR title includes the relevant Jira ticket ID (if applicable)
- [ ] The PR title includes a short change description to be used as the commit message
- [ ] I have checked this change against existing tests
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my change works as expected
- [ ] I have added necessary documentation (if applicable)
- [ ] I have checked the files added or changed against the relevant code style guide
- [ ] I have checked that there are alerts covering this change
- [ ] Any dependency changes needed have been merged to their main branch and published successfully

## Additional notes

If your proposed solution requires additional context or explanation, include it here.
